releases.name: AnyPS5 Studio v1.5.1
releases.body:
AnyPS5 Studio 1.5.1 updates the bundled AnyPS5 core from v0.1.2 to **[v0.1.4](https://github.com/boykopovar/AnyPS5/releases/tag/v0.1.4)**.

## Changes
- **AnyPS5 core v0.1.4**: the bundled relinker and system libraries now come from the latest upstream release. Existing installs switch to it automatically the next time Studio starts, and each game receives the new libraries on its next launch.
- **Relink hint**: Studio now remembers which core relinked each game. If a game was relinked with an earlier core, the launch log says so and suggests relinking it in Relinker Studio if it fails to start.
- **Verified core downloads**: the bundled core is checked against the SHA-256 checksums AnyPS5 publishes for the release; a mismatch stops the build.
- The NID inspector's "Python 3 not found" message now points to the correct re-audit button.

## After updating
If a game that worked before no longer starts, open **Relinker Studio** and relink it.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ramsforge/AnyPS5-Studio/compare/v1.5.0...v1.5.1

releases.name: AnyPS5 Studio v1.5.0
releases.body:
AnyPS5 Studio 1.5.0 is the biggest update so far: full controller support, playtime tracking, safer handling of your game folders, a faster app that works offline, and a round of security hardening.

## Highlights

### Full controller navigation
- Use the D-pad / left stick to move around every screen (menus, Settings, dialogs, setup and the launcher). Cross selects, Circle goes back, L1 / R1 switch tabs.
- On the game row, Left / Right still pick a game and Cross plays it; press Down to reach the game's buttons.
- Studio ignores the controller while you are playing a game, so button presses never reach Studio behind it.
- Controller rumble now follows the Haptic Feedback setting.
- Arrow keys and Escape work the same way on the keyboard.

### Playtime tracking
- Total playtime and your last session are recorded for every game and shown on the home screen.

### Safer game folders
- Studio only reorganizes folders that actually contain a PS5 title, and no longer moves game assets just because their name looks like a backup (for example `*.baked`).

releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.6

- Integrated Xenia Edge upstream through November 20, 2026. This brings updates across CPU and system emulation, graphics, audio and game content handling while preserving X360 Mobile's Android features and existing fixes.
- Improved handling of game updates and Android storage access. Updated the in-game interface and input handling.
- Continued work on reducing shader-related pauses at the beginning of **Fable II**. New scenes can still pause while shaders are prepared.

Focused checks on Odin 2 covered gameplay in **GTA IV**, **Forza Horizon 2** and **Fable II**, as well as pause, resume and shutdown in **Assassin's Creed**. Results can vary across titles, devices and drivers.

TV mode, synced player profiles and picture-in-picture remain experimental. You can install this release over your current version.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 8
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 8

This update improves graphics accuracy and adds better diagnostic information for investigating driver performance reports.

## General graphics correction

- Corrected a graphics accuracy issue observed as temporary black, blue or multicoloured corruption during the opening of **Fable II**.
- The correction applies automatically and may also help other games affected by similar rendering problems. No additional game setting is required for this correction; existing recommended settings remain available.
- Verified through two opening runs reaching the first childhood gameplay scene on Odin 2. Later scenes, full campaigns and other GPUs still need testing.
- This is an accuracy improvement, with no general FPS increase promised. Brief pauses may still occur when new shaders are prepared.

## Driver diagnostics and session sharing

- Added more useful texture and performance information for investigating reported slowdowns with **RADV on Exynos/Xclipse**.
- Gameplay measurement recordings are now associated with their session and can be included when using **Share session bundle** from Session history.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 7
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 7

This update brings a general graphics correctness improvement and experimental picture-in-picture support for external media apps.

## Graphics correction

- Fixed the horizontally divided image and missing lower portion observed in the opening real-time cutscene of **Kingdoms of Amalur: Reckoning**.
- This is a general core correction, applied automatically without additional settings. It may benefit other games affected by similar rendering problems, but wider game and GPU coverage still needs testing.
- Verified through repeated starts and progression to character creation on Odin 2. This does not certify the full campaign or promise a general FPS increase.

## Experimental picture-in-picture

- Keep the game full screen while a compatible external media app uses Android's floating video window.
- Added an app selector with PiP compatibility indicators, an optional media link, and controls in the game menu. Find these options under **Settings → App → Appearance and startup**.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 6
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 6

Maintenance update focused on optional driver compatibility and updated game recommendations.

- Added an optional experimental texture compatibility setting for RADV on Samsung Xclipse. It is disabled by default and has not yet been verified on Xclipse hardware. Successful driver loading, rendering and performance are not guaranteed; memory use may increase.
- Added recommended settings for **Mobile Suit Gundam: Operation Troy**, restoring the visible world in the first map tested on Odin 2. A complete game copy is required; other devices and the full campaign remain unverified.
- Added recommendations for **Sonic Free Riders with the adapted No Kinect mod**. The compatible adapted mod and its designated launcher are required: settings alone do not repair the original mod, and the mod is not bundled with the app. Menus and two tutorial stages were tested; uneven steering remains under investigation, and full-game compatibility is not confirmed.

releases.name: X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 5
releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 5

Maintenance update focused on game loading reliability and clearer driver diagnostics.

- Improved handling of extracted games, disc images and installed game containers.
- Added a per-game startup executable selector for games with multiple launchers.
- Improved reliability when loading additional game modules and title updates, with safer recovery after failed launches.
- Improved recognition of game files and preservation of launch preferences across library updates and shortcuts.
- More precise on-device Vulkan driver diagnostics, including the image check that failed and available error information.

Custom drivers remain device-dependent. More detailed diagnostics help investigate compatibility; they do not guarantee successful RADV loading or fix every game or mod.

Install over your current version; no uninstall is required. Keep a backup of your profiles and saves as usual.

releases.name: Cemu Plus 0.4.1
releases.body:
Android build of Cemu Plus, a fork of the Cemu Android port with Lossless Scaling frame generation.

## What's new

### Game updates
- **Use update** in the settings of a game, under Update, turns its installed update off, and the game runs as its base version. It's only shown for games with an update, and applies the next time the game starts. The game card shows the version the game runs as
- Games whose update doesn't work in Cemu have it off by default, with a note under the switch saying it's recommended off. **Why?** opens the reason

### Fixes
- ZombiU no longer stays on a black screen after the Ubisoft logo. Its update (v32) doesn't work in Cemu, so it's off by default and ZombiU runs as its base version


## Frame generation setup
1. Copy `Lossless.dll` from your own copy of Lossless Scaling (its installation folder on Windows) to your device.
2. In Cemu Plus open **Settings → Graphics settings → Frame generation (Lossless Scaling)** and tap **Select Lossless.dll**.
3. Enable frame generation there or from the in-game menu, where the multiplier, target frame rate and motion estimation resolution can be changed while playing.

Cemu Plus now includes everything the main Cemu project added since April 2026:

## Underground 1 Android Evolved v0.2.15: más rendimiento

### Cambios

- **Más rendimiento en procesadores con 2 núcleos rápidos** (Helio G85/G88/G99, MT6769/MT6789 y similares). En la versión anterior dejamos de fijar los hilos del juego a los núcleos rápidos en estos procesadores, y en algunos volvió el lag. Ahora el hilo principal del juego, el que más trabaja, va en los núcleos rápidos, y los demás hilos los reparte Android. Con 4 o más núcleos rápidos no cambia nada: todos los hilos van en ellos.
- **Menos trabajo inútil en cada fotograma.** El juego pregunta por `d3d9.dll` en cada fotograma, y el port lo anotaba en el registro cada vez: unas 2000 líneas por segundo en Most Wanted y Carbon. Ahora se anota una sola vez. Otras líneas repetitivas (texturas convertidas en la CPU, entrada de teclado, liberación de superficies) también se limitan. Además de ahorrar CPU, el registro de los reportes conserva lo importante.

Dos APK: **arm64** y **armeabi-v7a**. Android 10+, Vulkan 1.1+. Misma firma; se instalan como actualización. Se adjunta `NFSU1-v0.2.15-SHA256SUMS.txt`.

### Driver Vulkan recomendado para tu procesador

- **El launcher te dice qué driver usar.** En *Opciones › Driver Vulkan* ahora aparece la GPU de tu teléfono y el driver que le conviene:
  - **Snapdragon (Adreno 6xx/7xx):** Turnip (Mesa), si el driver del sistema va lento o con errores gráficos.

releases.name: Underground 1 Android Evolved v0.2.12
releases.body:
## Underground 1 Android Evolved v0.2.12: volver al juego sin cierres y reportes completos

### Correcciones

- **Cierre al volver al juego.** Si salías a otra app y volvías, el juego podía cerrarse en el primer fotograma. Android libera la ventana del juego al pasar a segundo plano, pero la superficie Vulkan seguía usándola y se destruía después. Ahora la superficie conserva su ventana hasta que se destruye.

### Reportes más útiles

- **El resumen del issue ya trae las líneas del juego.** Antes se tomaban de logcat y, cuando pulsabas *Reportar*, Android ya las había borrado: casi todos los issues llegaban con "últimas líneas del juego" vacío. Ahora salen del registro propio del juego (`game.log`), y logcat solo aporta las líneas del cierre.
- **Lecturas de archivo incompletas en el registro.** Si el juego pide más datos de los que recibe de un archivo, se anota el archivo, la posición y su tamaño. Así podremos ver si un cierre viene de un archivo del juego dañado o incompleto.

### Ajustes para teléfonos con GPU débil

Smoother frames, drivers for more Adreno phones, GPL-3.0.

## English

**Improved**
- Smoother and lighter frames: the graphics commands are prepared on a separate thread, and the GPU is kept from dropping its clock while frames run late.

- Mali with the PanVK driver: textures are now unpacked by the game itself, the same way as with the phone's own driver.

Two new rows in the settings panel (swipe in from the right edge of the screen):

# Arceus Recomp for Android — v1.0 

Android port of **PokeL-ARecomp**, the static recompilation of *Pokémon Legends: Arceus*. Tested on the AYN Odin 3 (Snapdragon 8 Elite, Adreno 830).

- **60 fps at 60 Hz with 100% resolution.**

- **Clock speeds:** the port tells Android how long each frame really takes, on the CPU and the GPU. The CPU no longer sits at max clock, and the GPU clocks up when it needs to.

- **Vulkan on Adreno**, with support for the **Turnip** (Mesa) driver, which you can import and pick from the menu.
- **"Soft" anti-aliasing** (new, default): blends the dithered pattern on hair, leaves and grass at no fps cost. SMAA is also available.

releases.body:
**Headlight beams in both games, and the first Android beta.** At night your car finally lights up the road ahead and we're releasing the Android version for further testing.

## Features

- **Headlight beams.** Turning your lights on at night now throws a beam of light onto the road ahead, as on the original Xbox: it brightens the street, cars and walls it reaches and stops where it meets them ([#10](https://github.com/laureladastra/mcdub3-nx/issues/10), thanks for the report). Before, the lights worked in the game but no beam was drawn. Other emulators (i.e. xemu → https://github.com/xemu-project/xemu/issues/996) show a solid white shape instead. The game builds the beam in a small hidden picture using two tricks of the Xbox's graphics chip that the port did not reproduce yet: it reuses a picture as a depth map, and it counts the beam's layers with a special blending mode that works with negative numbers. Both are emulated now. Tested in the DUB Edition and the Remix. The WHITE button flashes your high beams while you hold it. The main headlights are on by themselves at night.

releases.name: mcdub3-nx v1.0.0
releases.body:
**Version 1.0 for both games on the Nintendo Switch.** This release removes the last annoyances: races that felt slow when the frame rate dipped, random zoom-in or out during loading screens, and vertical lines during upscaling.

### Features

- **Races keep their real speed.** The original game moves the race forward by a fixed step every frame, which was fine on the Xbox, where it runs on a fixed 30 FPS. On the Switch, in rain, with nitrous or in the busiest streets, the frame rate can dip and the whole race then went into slow motion. The race now proceeds by the time that really passed. Racing in the rain and with nitrous feels much steadier.
- **No more random zooms during loading screens.** Menus and loading screens are drawn for 4:3 TVs, with black strips at the sides, and the port enlarges them to fill your 16:9 screen. When something briefly reached those strips (the circle animation on loading screens for example), the picture behind it jumped in size for a brief moment. The size stays put now.

releases.name: mcdub3-nx v0.5.0
releases.body:
**A big speed update for both games on the Switch.** Races, especially in the rain, now run close to the game's own top speed of 30 FPS most of the time. Freezes during races are minimised.

### Features

- Measured in rain races on the Switch (at the default 1x picture size):

  |                                    | v0.4.0                 | v0.5.0   |
  | ---------------------------------- | ---------------------- | -------- |
  | Midnight Club 3: DUB Edition       | 23 frames per second   | **28.5** |
  | Midnight Club 3: DUB Edition Remix | 20.5 frames per second | **27.5** |

  The game itself never runs faster than 30, as on the original Xbox, so most of the time you are now at or near full speed.
- **No more half-second freezes in races.** The game stopped for about half a second now and then during a race, most often right after the start.
- **Sharper look for less effort (Remix).** The Remix's glow and blur effects are drawn at normal size even when you raise the picture size, which cost a lot of speed for something that is blurred anyway.

### Other changes

- Each game now has its own tuned graphics settings, so improving one game does not change the other.

  to either port. Hot-plug devices in Configuration → Network, save them in
  profiles, or use `--usb1` / `--usb2` in the headless runner. USB4TOS drivers

- **Built-in NAT:** IPv4/IPv6 networking without libslirp or GLib, including
  DHCP, DNS, TCP/UDP and explicit port forwarding. STinG/ENEC can load HTTP pages.

remain external to save states. USB passthrough and isochronous transfers are not
implemented.

releases.name: NeoST 0.6.1
releases.body:
## NeoST 0.6.1 — your settings stay put

A patch release. No new features: **23 defects** found and fixed across five rounds of multi-agent bug hunting, plus a hardware-validation pass on the published packages.

### Settings are saved again

On macOS and on every AppImage, NeoST runs from **read-only media**, so it stores its configuration in your user directory — but it never created that directory, and every setting was silently lost when you closed the emulator. **Five of the eight packages were affected.** Machine profile, video, audio and MIDI setup now survive a restart.

### Also fixed

- **The macOS disk image installs by drag and drop.** It shipped with the app alone, no `Applications` shortcut.
- **The web build ships its licences** (GPL-3.0, GPL-2.0, third-party notices), like every other package.
- **A save-state can no longer be reloaded under a different ROM.** The pairing relied on two bytes of TOS version, which five localisations share, so resuming under the wrong ROM froze the CPU without a word. The state format is now **v19**; v18 and older are refused explicitly, with a message that says why.

> 💡 **Релиз 18.4.7** - *Оптимизация запуска и логов по результатам тестирования игр, а также единый 12-язычный стандарт окна обновлений для Windows и Android*

---

- **Ускорение прямого запуска игр (`-g` / CLI)**: При прямом запуске игры из командной строки или ярлыка откладывается фоновое сканирование каталогов, предзагрузка TitleDB, фоновая проверка обновлений и стартовый опрос каталога STORM GAMES WORLD, благодаря чему CPU, диск и память сразу отдаются запуску игры.

releases.name: STORM SWITCH 18.4.5

- 🌟 **Мгновенное завершение эмуляции (Xenoblade Chronicles 3 и др.)**: Устранены многосекундные задержки `CloseServices` (`hid`, `arp:r`, `psc:c`) - время закрытия сокращено с 9.10 с до 1.91 с.

releases.name: v0.4.10
releases.body:
Faster starts with mods installed, plus housekeeping for the releases themselves. Everything from [0.4.9](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.9) is included.

## Mods

- **Mods no longer slow down every start.** The port used to read every file of every mod in `mods` at each start to check it, which took seconds with big mods. It now remembers those checks and only reads a file again when its size or date changes. The first start after installing or updating a mod takes as long as before; the next ones skip that work.

## Android

- The APK's internal version number jumps from 39 to 4010. It still installs over the old one; nothing to do on your side.

## Install / update

Windows: download `gow2-recomp-0.4.10-win64.zip` and copy the **contents** of its `gow2-recomp-0.4.10-win64` folder into your game folder. Your `gow2.toml` and saves are kept.

releases.name: v0.4.9
releases.body:
Achievement names in Cyrillic, Korean and Chinese, a saving message that no longer mentions a console, better Mali detection on Android, Esc going back in menus, and the first community contributions, all from optimistic-blip. Everything from [0.4.8](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.8) is included.

## Fixes

- **Achievement names in every language (#54).** The achievement pop-up and the achievement list (F7) are drawn by the port with a small Latin-only font, so Russian, Polish, Czech, Hungarian, Korean and Chinese names showed up as `?????`. That font now gets Cyrillic and the Central European letters from a system font (Segoe UI on Windows, Roboto on Android), plus Korean or Traditional Chinese glyphs when the game runs in one of those languages.
- **"Please don't turn off your PC" (#64).** The checkpoint message said "console". It now says PC in all 12 languages, and "device" on Android. The text is changed at run time like the port's other text edits; the game folder is not touched. The idea, and a tool for changing the file itself, came from optimistic-blip.

releases.name: v0.4.8
releases.body:
Co-op settings no longer have to match between friends, players 3 and up get their own Centaur in the tank chapter, and the native renderer stops smearing textures on AMD cards. Everything from [0.4.7](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.7) is included.

## Co-op

- **The host's settings apply to everyone in that campaign.** Before, a friend whose co-op settings differed from the host's (player count, extra players ending the game, and so on) did not see the campaign at all. Now only the release has to match: friends see the host's campaign whatever their own `gow2_coop_players` and co-op options say, and the host's settings decide how that campaign plays. Campaigns from a different release still stay hidden, and since 0.4.8 that check covers two-player games too.
- **One Centaur per player in the tank chapter.** When Marcus drives the Centaur, every player 3 and up gets a tank of their own next to him instead of hanging off his. If someone leaves their tank, dies, or falls too far behind, they get a new one next to Marcus; the extra tanks go away when the tank section ends. `gow2_coop_tanks = false` turns it off.

releases.name: v0.4.7
releases.body:
Phones get new defaults that run smoother and cooler, voices on Android should come through again, and every platform gets a Render scale option. Everything from [0.4.6](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.6) is included.

## Android

- **Frame rate unlocked with a 45 fps limit, by default.** Uncapped, the phone's GPU runs at full load until the phone lowers its clock as it heats up; the limit keeps headroom. The limit drops to the nearest rate that divides your screen's refresh, so every frame lasts the same: 40 fps on a 120 Hz screen (Galaxy S24/S25), 45 at 90 Hz, 30 at 60 Hz. On an S25 Ultra frame times went from a 25/25/16.7 ms mix to an even 25 ms. You can still pick 30, 60 or no limit in Device Options > Display > Frame rate limit.
- **Render scale 75 % by default.** The 3D scene is drawn at 75 % and scaled up to the screen; on an S25 Ultra that is 14 % less GPU work per frame, with a slightly softer picture. Graphics > Render scale goes back to 100 %.
- **Snapdragon GSR for the final upscale by default**, one pass instead of FSR 1's two.

releases.name: v0.4.6
releases.body:
Insane can now be picked from the start. Everything from [0.4.5](https://github.com/santiquiroz/gears-of-war-2-pc-port/releases/tag/v0.4.5) is included; if you have not read its notes, they cover the Riftworm fix for Vulkan, GPU detection on Linux and Proton, and the co-op go-to-player-1 key.

## Every platform

- **Insane without finishing the campaign first.** The option from 0.4.5, now named **All chapters and Insane unlocked** (PC Options > Saves, on by default), also enables the Insane button in the difficulty menu, in solo Campaign and in the co-op lobby. Before, the game greyed it out until the campaign had been finished once. As with chapters, only the menu check changes: your saved progress and the Extras list of unlockables are not touched.

## Known, still open

- Lighting that looks pixelated on Linux with presets above Low, and black textures on Low on Windows (both on a Legion Go): we could not reproduce them on our PC. A screenshot and the `logs/gow2_*.log` of the run, with the chapter, help a lot.

releases.name: shadps4 v0.21.0 - codename Until Mavethee Dawn
releases.body:
Another week another release . There are ton of changes , so why not ? 

## Core
* Properly check where an input came from for digital->analog input smoothing
* cpu_patches: Work around Rosetta 2 mistranslating negated scalar compares 
* file_sys: Report stable file identities in stat and fstat 
* Allow file type identification for '/addcont' path
* emulator: stop clearing temporary data on boot 
* Add PT_SCE_MODULE_PARAM case
* cpu_patches: Fix JIT patching at addresses outside any module
* core: Fix MemoryManager::Free unmapping past the released rang
* file_sys: don't abort when a guest path goes through a regular file
* use VMA pointers instead of copies in TryWriteBacking 
* cpu_patches: Workaround Rosetta 2 crash on VMASKMOVPS/PD
* Handle ELF metadata and toolchain comments program headers
* common: reuse one high-resolution waitable timer per thread in AccurateSleep
* Don't abort when optional ELF metadata segments can't be read
* cpu_patches: Fix register clobbering in Rosetta 2 VMASKMOV workaround 
* renderdoc: Add library name for macOS
* renderdoc: Add alternate path for macOS 
* lru_cache: Fix early stop in ForEachItemBelow

Stephen if you are reading this we already miss you ;/

* cpu_patches: Apply comprehensive SSE4a CPU patches on macOS 
* Shutdown NpHandler before restarting

* Speed up game ID resolution

releases.name: shadps4 v0.18.0 - codename UltraPersona
releases.body:
shadPS4 v0.18.0 "UltraPersona"

Hello there, it hasn't been a while, has it? While not much time has passed since our last stable release, we are here again with a brand new one. The main reason for this release is broken shadNet authorization in certain cases on the 0.17.0 release, but we have some more interesting new features as well.

Firstly, after some fixes, AvPlayer can now be loaded as LLE, meaning that you need the `libSceAvPlayer.sprx` (and `libSceAvPlayerStreaming.sprx`) module(s), which makes broken videos in a few games now work properly.

The above change was enabled by calling `sceLibcInternalMemoryMutexEnable` in LLE LibcInternal at boot, found by [@liuk7071](https://github.com/liuk7071), the developer of ChonkyStation4, another PS4 emulator.

A kernel event flag rewrite has also fixed Shadow of the Colossus often hanging on boot, and the game now consistently gets to menus.

releases.name: RunnerBuilder 0.3.3
releases.body:
Builds your own Android APK of the PC version from your own copy of Mirror's Edge from GOG. Other releases of the game do not work.

**New in 0.3.3: much faster.**
- Before the build the program asks where the result goes: a device over USB or Wi-Fi debugging, or a folder only. With a device, the game files are copied to it **while** the game's code is being built, and the finished app is installed at the end. No ZIP is made then.
- A first build takes about 5 minutes on a fast PC (was about 10): the translation runs in parallel and a 2-3 minute stall at the end of every build is gone.
- The build is kept: after an update of the program it takes a minute or two instead of starting over.
- The window is sharp on screens scaled to 125-200%.
- App 0.3.3: no more 1-second freezes when the game restarts its rendering thread (a sleep in the game's own code, skipped); PlayStation button icons when a DualSense is connected during play; a clear message while the game's code is still being built.

Tested on one PC and a Lenovo Y700: a full build with install over Wi-Fi in about 5 minutes. **Not tested yet:** the full 11.5 GB copy during a build, USB, the 1-second freeze fix in long play.

releases.name: NSP Box 4.0.0 — Meet NUP
releases.body:
# NSP Box 4.0.0 — Meet NUP

Smaller archives, flexible packaging, and more control over your game collection. Version 4.0 introduces **NUP Tools**, alongside the existing NSP builder.

### Package more. Store less.

- **Create compressed NUP archives** from extracted game folders, with base games, updates and DLC together in one file.
- **Choose your balance:** Fast for quicker compression, Balanced for everyday use, or Smaller for stronger compression. Incompressible files are stored raw automatically.
- **Keep what you need:** select Base, Updates and DLC independently. Choices appear after inspection, only for content present in your source. Latest-snapshot mode merges the newest selected update with the selected base, retains required base-only files, and leaves superseded versions behind. Turn it off to keep separate base/update records.
- **Avoid duplicate storage:** identical file contents can share the same space inside an archive.
- **Stay compatible:** leave files larger than 256 MiB uncompressed to reduce temporary decompression work in supported emulators.

### Convert, extract and check

- **NSP → NUP:** compress plaintext NSPs created by NSP Box.

releases.name: NSP Box 3.1.0
releases.body:
# NSP Box 3.1.0

- **Selevet support:** the emulator patcher now supports Selevet Eglantine performance build 4, including both normal and 30 FPS Windows downloads.
- **Future-build matching:** minor Selevet updates can be recognized when the reviewed loader and metadata-reader fingerprints still match. Unverified matches are labeled experimental; changed or ambiguous hooks are refused.
- **Settings preserved:** adding or removing the metadata patch keeps `nx2_switches.txt` and the existing 30 FPS setting unchanged. Exact original executable backups remain available for removal.
- **Supported-build list:** added Selevet and adjusted the patch dialog so its full compatibility list remains visible.
- **Validation:** both Selevet downloads passed byte-exact patch removal, isolated native hook checks and real startup timing comparisons. Patched startup without a companion matched the external-NPDM path at 31.25 MHz. These checks do not establish gameplay compatibility or FPS gains.

releases.name: NSP Box 3.0.0
releases.body:
# NSP Box 3.0.0

- **New branding:** NSP Box, with redesigned icons and a new app logo.
- **Smoother UI:** subtle animated background, fluid transitions, and improved spacing.
- **NSP-only packaging:** removed XCI output from games and DLC.
- **Dedicated DLC tab:** create separate DLC NSPs for compatible emulators. Thanks [@ryzendew](https://github.com/ryzendew) for requesting separate packages in [#1](https://github.com/smarkyie/switch2-game-packager/issues/1).
- **Expanded patch support:** Eglantine build 98, AMD Experimental build-99, and PokeDinner 2.1.0a. Supported builds are now listed in the patch panel.
- **Fixed drag-and-drop crashes:** artwork and folder drops no longer crash the app. Thanks [@WicCaesar](https://github.com/WicCaesar) for reporting [#2](https://github.com/smarkyie/switch2-game-packager/issues/2).
- **Windows x64 portable release**, with source code included as a separate download.
- **Existing game packages don't need rebuilding** to use the expanded emulator patch support.

**Experimental build — limited real-world testing.** Emulator and DLC compatibility varies. Supported patched emulators can load packages without an external `main.npdm`.

releases.name: Switch 2 Game Packager 2.0.0
releases.body:
# Switch 2 Game Packager 2.0.0

- **New Emulator patch panel:** select a Windows x64 emulator folder, check compatibility, add the patch and remove it later. Eglantine build 96 standard/PGO and PokeDinner 2.0.0 GUI/CLI profiles are recognized; matching future builds and forks can be tried experimentally without a new menu entry.
- **No separate `main.npdm` needed after patching:** compatible emulators read Switch 2 metadata already embedded inside this packager's plaintext XCI/NSP. Restart the emulator after applying the patch. Existing packages do not need rebuilding, and the packager need not remain open while playing.
- To create only a single XCI/NSP, uncheck **Create package folder**. The option remains on by default for unpatched emulators; without the patch, retain each game's exact external companion in its own folder. Selecting 12 GiB alone can still use incorrect timing and reduce performance.

releases.name: Switch 2 Game Packager 1.4.4
releases.body:
# Switch 2 Game Packager 1.4.4

- Add the reported performance drop without an external `main.npdm` to the startup caution, Notes & compatibility, README and release notes.
- Recommend keeping **Create package folder** enabled and retaining its companion beside the game. The performance observation is user-reported, not a controlled benchmark.
- Refresh remembered-caution preferences so the new warning is shown after an older notice was dismissed.
- Retain the 12 GiB guidance, default-on package-folder option and single-file output when unchecked. Packaging behavior is unchanged from 1.4.3.

Portable Windows x64 build. Extract the complete Windows ZIP and run `Switch2-XCI-Packager.exe`. Source, licenses and build notes are included. No game data, artwork, firmware or retail keys are included.

**Caution — experimental:** set emulator memory to **12 GiB** before testing Switch 2 packages. Booting without an external companion was reported in PokeDinner 2.0.0 with this setting; other games/builds may differ. The app does not change emulator memory settings. Verification does not guarantee booting or gameplay.

## What's New

- **Root performance profile:** device-aware, root-manager permission-gated CPU/GPU governor and I/O scheduler controls, with restoration of previous settings when gameplay pauses or exits. - **Steam integration and download improvements:** browse the Store and library, install Windows depots, manage downloads, view friends/chat, profile, achievements, badges, and Steam News, and create game shortcuts. - **PanVK release tracking(Auto Update):** browse release feeds from zenithblue-oss, GunaCharanTeja, FristOneRR, Noysz, and Faux123.

This update brings Winlator Mali+ up to the Winlator Mali Bionic 1.2.1 source, along with Mali+ improvements to the interface, artwork handling, and virtual input compatibility.

- Refined Liquid Glass styling across dialogs, dropdowns, cards, and in-game surfaces.
- Enhanced Liquid Glass is enabled by default on fresh installs. Toggle it in **Settings > Appearance & Themes > Theme & Colors > Enhanced Liquid Glass**; turning it off disables the enhanced animated-backdrop treatment, while popup/dialog blur remains available.

- Fixed container-list refresh after creating a container.

releases.name: Winlator Mali 1.2+ Update — Vulkan, PanVK & Shortcut Enhancements
releases.body:
Winlator Mali+ 1.2 update, based on Winlator Mali 1.2 Bionic Latest. This update keeps the upstream EGL/Gladio renderer and ZeroFG path while adding optional Vulkan and game-library improvements.

## Highlights

- Optional Vulkan host renderer with renderer configuration, native-rendering/scanout support, and Vulkan LSFG/Win-FG controls.
- Online Bannerlator wrapper catalog with installed-wrapper selection and archive validation.
- Live PanVK release browser in Adrenotools GPU Drivers. Refreshes GitHub releases from three projects, filters for recognized Adrenotools ZIP packages, verifies downloads, and imports drivers directly.
- Shortcut-library improvements: full-cover portrait and landscape cards, per-game artwork handling, executable shortcut creation with container selection, and selected-game graphics details.
- Animated PlayStation-inspired backgrounds and liquid-glass styling across application and in-game menus.

## Experimental PanVK notice

## Winlator Mali+ 1.2 Bionic

A customized Winlalor mali from [GunaCharanTeja](https://github.com/GunaCharanTeja) an improved console-inspired game library, downloadable graphics wrappers, and an experimental Vulkan rendering/frame-generation path.

### Highlights & Features
- Winlator Mali+ branding and an animated, responsive launcher with portrait/landscape game cards, selectable shortcuts, game cover art, and a compact per-game summary of Vulkan wrapper, FEXCore, Box64, and presets.
- Cloud-fetched and custom game cover art, with local fallback behavior when online artwork is unavailable.
- Bannerlator wrapper catalog integration: browse, download/update, checksum-verify, and select wrappers per container or shortcut; saved selections are restored and applied when launching a game.
- Vulkan host renderer settings for color order, present mode, and installed host driver, plus optional Native Rendering/low-latency scanout.
- Experimental native Win-FG frame generation and optional LSFG Native after importing and validating the user's own `Lossless.dll`; the DLL is not bundled. Compatibility depends on the Vulkan driver/device.

releases.name: XHYN V 0.3 Preview 4
releases.body:
# XHYN V 0.3 Preview 4

## What's new

- Vulkan Drivers and DXVK show what the game last loaded and what is selected for the next launch, including driver fallback.
- Driver ZIP imports show progress, can be cancelled, and keep your current driver selected. You can now view and clear shader caches individually.
- The touch layout editor has snap-to-grid and safe-area guides. Controls has a controller test for buttons, sticks, and dead zones.
- LAN room details show the host, local or virtual connection, and build compatibility information. You can view your enabled resource mods and measure outgoing traffic from the room.
- Large settings files can no longer stop launch when diagnostics tries to copy them. Startup also does less work on repeated package checks and optional reports.
- Supported phones have an optional sustained performance mode. Graphics startup errors now identify a rejected Direct3D feature level when the log records it.

## Install

Install **XHYN-V-0.3-preview4.apk** over Preview 3 Hotfix 1 to keep your settings. Use your own compatible GTA V Legacy files. [Buy GTA V](https://store.rockstargames.com/game/buy-gta-v)

# XHYN V 0.3 Preview 2 — launcher startup fix

Preview 1 could close immediately without showing the launcher. Its rebuilt APK omitted 146 original artwork files required during application startup. Preview 2 restores those files, preserves their authentication and touch icons, and adds checks using the final signed APK's own resources.

Install **XHYN-V-0.3-Preview2.apk** over Preview 1; the app ID and release key are unchanged, and the version code is newer. There is no need to uninstall first. **XHYN V Bridge stays at 0.1.0**; an already installed copy does not need updating.

All 0.3 features remain: the 1.7.57 multiplayer base, LAN free roam, room chat, shared vehicles, street races, themes, XHYN graphics/DXVK controls and diagnostics. See the full [changelog and multiplayer guide](https://github.com/XHYN-PH/XHYN-V-reborn/blob/v0.3-preview2/README.md).

releases.body:
# Ymir v0.4.0
[Discord](https://discord.gg/NN3A7n5dzn) | [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/StrikerX3) | [Compatibility list](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SLZzL9LelSlpEmTKy8cjaQnE7mew2uW1rfCgcekO58Q/edit?usp=sharing) | [Screenshots](https://emu.layle.dev/ymir/54fead6/)

SDL Renderer has been the backbone of graphics on Ymir... until now. Ymir now supports Direct3D 12 and Metal (with Vulkan to come in the future), which will enable implementation of shaders and resolution scaling down the line. Direct3D 12 also supports hardware-accelerated VDP rendering, offloading heavy graphics computations to your GPU for a significant performance boost with no accuracy compromises -- it's as accurate as the software renderer, save for undiscovered bugs. Other graphics backends will eventually support acceleration as well, hang tight!

The Virtua Gun has been promoted to a stable feature after numerous bug fixes and accuracy improvements that made it work flawlessly with most supported games. Known issues are listed in #787: only one game doesn't register shots, and three don't recognize reloads consistently.

releases.name: Ymir v0.3.2
releases.body:
# Ymir v0.3.2
[Discord](https://discord.gg/NN3A7n5dzn) | [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/StrikerX3) | [Compatibility list](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1SLZzL9LelSlpEmTKy8cjaQnE7mew2uW1rfCgcekO58Q/edit?usp=sharing) | [Screenshots](https://emu.layle.dev/ymir/584dcc1/)

This release brings a large set of bug fixes and accuracy improvements once again guided by @celeriyacon's test ROMs, pushing compatibility to just over 94%! A workaround for 16 games described below would bring this number to 94.6%.

The highlight of this version is the huge set of fixes to CD Block HLE, bringing more parity with the LLE counterpart and improving compatibility and stability with dozens of games. VDP1 fixes also resolved a few longstanding issues and brought some games to life.

Performance got another huge boost in multiple avenues with this version. First, thanks to @SternXD, you can now offload audio processing tasks to another CPU core, freeing up the emulator thread to focus more heavily on the SH-2s and general system logic. This alone can boost performance by up to 25% and possibly more, depending on how much work is put on the SCSP DSP.

# PanProbe 1.3.2

Vulkan conformance and performance probe for the Mesa PanVK driver on Mali GPUs (mali_kbase). It loads the bundled driver, the system Vulkan driver or an imported `.so`, shows what the driver reports, and runs **41** on-device tests.

Bundled drivers:
- `rc5` slot (default): [Mesa PanVK 26.3.1](https://github.com/zenithblue-oss/panvk-kbase-android/releases/tag/panvk-kbase-v26.3.1), `26.3.0-devel (git-795ca7ff3e, p0175, 2026-10-31)`, build 122i, universal Mali v6-v14 (v15 not fully supported).
- `rc4` slot: the RC4 driver (`panvk-kbase-v0.1.0-rc4`), for A/B runs.

Package `dev.zenithblue.panvktest`, versionName 1.3.2, versionCode 21. It updates 1.2.7 and 1.3.x in place.

## What is new since 1.2.7

- Bundles build 122i (26.3.1) in the default slot; the `rc4` slot keeps RC4 for A/B runs.

releases.name: BioShock Classic for Android v0.3-dev
releases.body:
Development release of the experimental Android ARM64 port of BioShock Classic. Changes since v0.2.1-dev.

## Saves and stability

- Save files are written to a temporary file, validated, synchronized and atomically committed after the last handle closes. Write, sync and rename errors reach the game; failed temporary files are retained for possible recovery.
- Existing saves are validated before enumeration. Damaged files are omitted and quarantined under `SaveGames/damaged/`, fixing the main-menu crash path caused by an interrupted save. Checks cover headers, PNG thumbnails, metadata and zlib packages. This does not repair damaged save data.
- Added a workaround for device loss in high-quality bloom passes on Adreno 650 with the bundled Turnip driver reporting Vulkan API 1.3.335.

## Performance and rendering

- Optimized static index buffers, occlusion query batching, query reset and nonblocking result reads, and deferred offscreen clears on PanVK / Mali-G76 MC4. Automatic enablement is restricted to the measured GPU model.
- Updated bundled PanVK with deferred occlusion availability for Bifrost v7, command batch cleanup fixes and allocation error handling.

releases.name: BioShock Classic for Android v0.2.1-dev
releases.body:
Development release of the experimental Android ARM64 port of BioShock Classic. Changes since v0.2-dev:

## Changes and fixes

- Added crash reports with a copy-to-clipboard button. Reports are saved under `BioShock/crashes` and include the game log, build information and available native crash details. Crash monitoring can be disabled in the launcher.
- Fixed a buffer overflow when taking research-camera photos. Vulkan and OpenGL ES now respect the source and destination regions and resize the captured image to 256 x 256.
- Added movement-stick settings for the dead zone, visibility and fixed position.
- Added a slide-out weapon and plasmid inventory bar for the Port touch layout. Its **Weapon selection: On/Off** toggle is on **Input and prompts**. Weapon swipes now use a larger threshold and a rate limit for more controlled selection.
- Made the map and journal use interfaces that support both touch and gamepad input.
- Added launcher cleanup options for unused installation files and rebuildable caches. Limited diagnostic log growth and removed stale shader cache entries.

releases.name: BioShock Classic for Android v0.2-dev
releases.body:
Development release of the experimental Android ARM64 port of BioShock Classic. Changes since v0.1.1-dev:

## Performance and rendering

- Moved Vulkan pipeline and OpenGL ES program warm-up to low-priority background workers, with a larger seed recorded across all 15 levels. Cached results are reused on later starts.
- Reduced loading stalls through fairer thread handoffs, background logging and memory cleanup, texture read-ahead, and caching repeated missing-file checks.
- Removed redundant Vulkan buffer bindings and OpenGL ES state changes. Fixed compressed-texture uploads and preserved the aspect ratio when changing render resolution.
- Fixed first-person weapon and arm framing on wide screens while preserving world FOV, weapon FOV, and zoom settings.
- Updated bundled PanVK; compatible Mali devices can now use it on Android 11 or later. Added an Adreno 618 workaround for GPU loss with bundled Turnip.
- Renderer startup failures and device/context loss now return to the launcher with a reason and an offer to select another renderer.
- ADPF is now off by default.

## Controls and interface

releases.name: BioShock Classic for Android v0.1.1-dev
releases.body:
Second development release of the experimental Android ARM64 port of BioShock Classic.

## Controls and interface

- Added iPhone and iPad touch layouts alongside the port layout and a hidden-controls mode. The iOS layouts use 52 original sprites, including eight weapon icons and 22 plasmid icons. They show the equipped weapon and plasmid, the active slot, crouch or stand state, and the alternate reload icon in plasmid mode.
- Added a 50–200% iOS control scale and context-sensitive Hack, Rescue, and Harvest buttons. Control groups scale together and the left group accounts for the health and ammo HUD. Map and Pause activate on release over the same button.
- Kept movement and camera gestures available with the overlay hidden. Fixed absolute touch coordinates at screen edges and input recovery after graphics changes or a stalled input event.
- Added phone vibration for in-game rumble and touch feedback, with an on/off switch and strength adjustment in 25% steps.
- Added optional touch aim assist using BioShock's controller aim system. Each touch sample is consumed once, and direct touch look remains available when the game's aim properties are unavailable.

releases.name: BioShock Classic for Android v0.1-dev
releases.body:
First development release of the experimental Android ARM64 port of BioShock Classic. The port uses ahead-of-time recompilation of the original Windows x86 code.

## Features

- OpenGL ES 3.2 and Vulkan rendering, with bundled Turnip and PanVK options for compatible GPUs.
- Touch controls, gamepad input, and configurable controls.
- Launcher with folder and ZIP game-data import, renderer selection, optional texture conversion, and update checks.

## Requirements and installation

- An ARM64 Android device running Android 8.0 or later. OpenGL ES 3.2 is the default renderer. See the repository README for Vulkan and driver requirements.
- Your own installation of **BioShock Classic for Windows, patch 1.1, GOG build 127339**. The original game files are required separately.
- Sideload the APK. Copy your Classic game folder to the device with its `Builds/` and `Content/` directories, then select that folder under **Game data** in the launcher and press **Play**.

## Known limitations

Device, driver, and full-campaign testing is limited in this development release.
